A map f:X→Y of topological spaces is surjective exactly when its underlying set-function has image Y. In the submersive map the additional continuity and quotient topology are distinct requirements; in the R-module case the linear structure is separate. Both source phrases therefore invoke the same general onto-codomain predicate without conflating their map structures.
